title: Run a manual audit on a target site
description: Verifies that a user can enter a target URL, run a manual audit, and review the resulting health score and telemetry details.
category: Core Web Vitals and DOM Diagnostics

steps.description: Enter a target URL in the manual target input
Verify a health score is displayed
Verify telemetry cards and LCP breakdown details are displayed

title: Audit the active target site context
description: Verifies that a user can use the active site context to run a manual audit and review Core Web Vitals diagnostics and attribution details.
category: Core Web Vitals and DOM Diagnostics

steps.description: Run a manual audit using the active target site context
Verify Core Web Vitals diagnostics are displayed
Verify element-level attribution details are displayed

title: Save a prospect to the lead pipeline
description: Verifies that a user can save the current prospect site and see the new lead appear in the saved pipeline.

steps.description: Verify the saved lead entry is displayed

title: Generate an outreach script for each channel
description: Verifies that a user can switch among outreach channels and generate a usable pitch script for the selected channel.

steps.description: Switch to the Merchant Pitch channel
Switch to the Agency Pitch channel
Verify a generated outreach script is displayed

title: Run a head-to-head comparison against a competitor site
description: This verifies that a user can open competitor comparison, enter a competitor URL, run the comparison, and review the performance breakdown.

steps.description: Enter a valid competitor website URL into the competitor field
Verify a win-loss breakdown is displayed

title: Compare the current target against a competitor after using the active site
description: This verifies that the comparison flow works when the user uses the currently active target site instead of entering a new target first.

steps.description: Enter a valid competitor website URL into the competitor field
Verify the target site is included in the comparison results

title: Update outreach tone and copy the script
description: Verifies that changing the outreach tone updates the generated script and that the user can copy it to the clipboard.

steps.description: Verify the outreach script reflects the selected tone
Verify a copy confirmation is visible

title: Change a saved lead deal status
description: Verifies that a user can update a lead's deal status and keep the pipeline organized with the new status reflected.

steps.description: Verify the updated deal status is displayed

title: Activate Pro with a valid license key
description: This verifies that a user can open activation, submit a valid key, and see the subscription status update successfully.

steps.description: Click the PRO badge or upgrade control
Enter a valid license key into the activation field
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the active subscription badge is visible

title: Start cloud vault synchronization after activation
description: This verifies that a user can activate Pro and then start cloud vault synchronization successfully.

steps.description: Click the PRO badge or upgrade control
Enter a valid activation key into the activation field
Verify the active subscription badge is visible

title: Delete a lead from the pipeline
description: Verifies that a user can remove a lead from the saved pipeline and no longer see it in the list.

steps.description: Verify the lead is removed from the pipeline

title: Export the lead pipeline as CSV
description: Verifies that a user can export the saved leads list as a CSV file from the pipeline.

steps.description: Export the lead list as CSV
Verify a CSV export confirmation is visible

title: Save agency branding details
description: This verifies that a user can enter agency branding details and save them for white-label use.

steps.description: Enter an agency brand name into the brand name field
Enter an auditor name into the auditor name field
Enter a website into the website field
Verify the saved branding details are retained
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Keep agency branding after reopening settings
description: This verifies that saved white-label branding values remain available after the user returns to the settings panel.

steps.description: Enter an agency brand name into the brand name field
Enter an auditor name into the auditor name field
Enter a website into the website field
Open the agency settings control again
Verify the saved branding details are retained

title: Reject an empty competitor URL
description: This verifies that the comparison modal prevents running a comparison when the competitor URL is missing and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Leave the competitor URL field empty
Verify a URL validation error is visible
Verify no comparison results are displayed

title: Show duplicate save handling for a prospect
description: Verifies that saving the same current prospect again does not create a duplicate lead entry.

steps.description: Save the current prospect site again
Verify only one lead entry is displayed for the prospect

title: Reject an invalid competitor URL
description: This verifies that the comparison flow validates malformed competitor URLs before starting a comparison.

steps.description: Enter an invalid competitor website URL into the competitor field
Verify a URL validation error is visible
Verify no comparison results are displayed

title: Reject a malformed activation key
description: This verifies that malformed activation input is blocked and the user sees activation validation feedback.

steps.description: Click the PRO badge or upgrade control
Enter a malformed license key into the activation field
Verify an activation validation error is visible
Verify the active subscription badge is not visible
